sloka: स्वसैन्यमुत्सृज्य समेत्य तूर्णं महारणे वानरवाहिनीषु।अदृश्यमानः शरजालमुग्रं ववर्ष नीलाम्बुधरो यथा ऽम्बु ।। ६.७३.४९ ।।
transliteration: svasainyamutsṛjya sametya tūrṇaṁ mahāraṇe vānaravāhinīṣu।adṛśyamānaḥ śarajālamugraṁ vavarṣa nīlāmbudharo yathā 'mbu ।। 6.73.49 ।।

translations.english: Highly enraged like the fire at the time of universal destruction, he tormented many chiefs of Vanaras and others.
